{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the highest sample_seq for each patient
deduped_data = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
# This is not needed for response rate, but we do it to be safe
filtered_data = deduped_data[deduped_data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Now, focus on the treatment arm
# Check the distribution of severity in treatment arm
print("Severity distribution in treatment arm:")
print(filtered_data[filtered_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['severity'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check sex distribution in treatment arm
print("\nSex distribution in treatment arm:")
print(filtered_data[filtered_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['sex'].value_counts())

# Check response rates by sex in treatment arm
# Compute raw response rates
treatment_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['arm'] == 'treatment']
response_by_sex = treatment_data.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("\nRaw response rates by sex in treatment arm:")
print(response_by_sex)

# Compute difference in response rates
response_diff = response_by_sex['F'] - response_by_sex['M']
print(f"\nDifference in response rates (F - M): {response_diff:.4f} ({response_diff*100:.2f}%)")"}
